title: Build the state.vscdb fixture generator
description:
Build a fixture generator that writes small state.vscdb files at test time into a temp dir: a global DB with composerData/bubbleId entries and a workspace DB pair, in both the 2.x (composer.composerData allComposers) and 3.x (composer.composerHeaders) index shapes, with WAL siblings. Committing binary SQLite fixtures is avoided; generation keeps fixtures diffable and schema-explicit.

Done when: the generator produces databases the discovery code reads end to end, and tests run hermetically without a real Cursor profile.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Fixture generator at tests/unit/sentiment/helpers/cursor-fixture.ts writes global + workspace DB pairs at test time into a temp dir (node:sqlite DatabaseSync), in 2.x (composer.composerData allComposers) and 3.x (composer.composerHeaders per-composer keys) shapes, with bubbleId blobs, fullConversationHeadersOnly ordering, workspace.json, optional -wal/-shm siblings, and agent-transcript JSONL trees. Binary fixtures are never committed. Tests run hermetically. Outcome: green.
